title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
blurb: Made very deep networks trainable by having each block learn a residual added to an identity shortcut, winning ImageNet 2015 with 152 layers.
intro: A residual block computes $x + F(x)$, so its default behaviour is the identity and gradients have a direct path through every block. When a block changes resolution or width, the shortcut becomes a strided 1×1 projection. The steps build convolution, batch norm, pooling and both block types; the capstone stacks a stem, residual stages, global average pooling and a classifier.
